content.text: Both candidate sections are now fully exhausted. Confirmed: no non-solicit exists anywhere.

input.rationale:
The agreement contains no employee non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding Mortgage Logic.com, so it matches the playbook's preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer") and requires no redline.

Basis: (1) Document-wide searches for the rule's detection triggers ("solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel", "recruit", "solicitation", "directly or indirectly") return no restrictive-covenant language; the only hits are § 7's unsolicited commercial e-mail (spam) provision and references to "employees" in § 8(c) access control and § 12 indemnity beneficiary lists. (2) Every "shall not" obligation imposed on Client is unrelated: anti-spamming (§ 7), the underwriting-decision notification restriction (§ 8(b)), and IP non-infringement warranties (§ 8(e)). (3) § 10 Confidentiality, the other likely home for such a covenant, is limited to Proprietary Information handling and its exceptions. (4) The "Non-Competition Agreement" referenced in § 8(d) is invoked solely as a limit on the credit-data license grant; it does not incorporate any personnel restriction into this agreement, though we should confirm that separate instrument carries no employee non-solicit when it is reviewed.

The deterministic checks that failed (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) test the fallback wording of a non-solicit clause and are non-probative where no such clause exists. Because the silence favors us, we should not volunteer a mutual non-solicit. If TrueLink raises one, we would hold it to the fallback only: personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire language. This is stated as a negotiation reserve, not a proposed edit.
